reason: Arithmetic lens: the claimed +0.0028 cannot happen, and the real ceiling is below the +0.002 gate. (1) Marginal values on the exp39 lab: D = TP+FP+FN = 122,151+6,846+6,732 = 135,729. Turning an FN into a TP is worth +1/D = 7.37e-6, dropping an FP +J/D = 6.63e-6 (J = 0.900), and a full FP->TP flip ~1.40e-5. Relink is a 1:1 Hungarian over fixed nodes, so the node multiplier and the division term are ~unchanged. (2) The hypothesis double-counts. Of the '~450 TP / ~340 FP' pockets, the 341 TP (unscored & ILP both none) and the 116 TP (u_diverted zero-prob in-edges) are ALREADY true positives, so 'fixing' them is worth 0. The pockets hold only 268 + 73 = 341 FP errors. Oracle for dropping all of them with no TP loss: 341 x 6.63e-6 = +0.0023. Converting each into its true link as well: +0.0048, but the FN partners are the u_diverted/swap node-position class, where the 2x2 re-assignment measured 0.0000 / -0.00004. (3) Reach of the mechanism: the relink cost (exp39 nb line 1048) is motion + 0.05*raw - BONUS*prob in um. A sidecar prob is < 0.48 by construction, so it moves a cost by at most 0.48 um (0.72 um at BONUS 1.5). Near-tie count from the per-edge parquet, using min(alt_tgt_um, alt_src_um) - len_um as the margin proxy: in the ILP-both-none pocket the margin median is 5.0 um, and only 13 evaluable edges (4 TP / 9 FP) sit within 0.48 um (15 edges, 5 / 10, within 0.72). So that pocket's reachable ceiling is 9 x 1.4e-5 = +0.00013. Over ALL 128,997 evaluable edges, 332 near-ties (199 TP / 133 FP) sit within 0.48 um. Flipping every FP near-tie correctly with no TP loss gives 133 x 1.4e-5 = +0.0019, below the gate. At BONUS 1.5 there are 162 FP near-ties (+0.0023), and even that needs zero damage to the 288 TP near-ties. u_diverted/swap geometry (our link ~1.4 um vs GT-pair endpoints 4-9 um apart) puts those margins at several um, far outside 0.48 um. (4) Realistic capture: the near-ties are 60% TP and edge_prob has AUC ~0.85, so the expected net is about +0.0000 to +0.0003 local. That is roughly 10-15% of an already sub-gate oracle, before any in-sample discount. The OOF retrain part adds no score. Its 'decision value' (avoiding one -0.002 mis-adoption) is already supplied for free by probe 29's LB delta. Verdict: cannot reach +0.002, and each embryo cannot reach +0.001.
fix_if_any: No version reaches the gate through relink costs. The only arithmetically meaningful remnant is the ~341 pocket FP, which are a DROP problem, not a cost problem (the ILP-both-none drop-all was -0.0007 because precision there is 56% > break-even 47%). A repair would need a discriminator that removes those FP at precision > 0.9, and earlier measurements show post-hoc drop scorers are dead (best +0.0002). If a GPU capture pass (exp51/V1284) runs anyway, dump the p>=0.05 sidecar for free and test BONUS 1.0 as a zero-cost add-on. Treat anything under +0.002 as zero, and never spend an LB slot or a dedicated GPU run on it. Put the ~2,700 swap/diverted FN (oracle +0.03-0.046) into node positions and duplicate merging instead.
realistic_public_gain: ~+0.0000 (range -0.001 to +0.0003). The oracle ceiling for relink-reachable errors is +0.0019 (BONUS 1.0) to +0.0023 (BONUS 1.5), achievable only with perfect flips. The realistic capture is 10-15% of that, before the in-sample discount.
